meta.name: Meridian Mutual Bank synthetic complaint corpus - dev set (same-author)
meta.note: 15 cases for iterating on extraction and checks. Same-author results must be labeled as such. The frozen 40-case set is the reported evaluation. All content invented.

cases.subject: ATM fee
cases.body: Hi, I'm Nora Bishop, account ending 3310. On November 3 I was charged a $3.50 out-of-network ATM fee at an ATM your own locator listed as in-network. Please refund. Nora

cases.body: This is Omar Farouk, account ending 7745. The app crashes when I open Bill Pay since the November 2 update. Please fix. Omar
